summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) filed an 8-K announcing a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger dated April 19, 2026, to acquire SVRE Holdings Ltd. via its wholly owned BVI subsidiary, Middlebury Merger Sub Ltd. The filing does not disclose exact terms, price per share, premium, or consideration type. No board recommendation or advisor is named in the excerpt. The transaction uses a reverse triangular merger structure with a BVI target. The deal is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals. Watch for shareholder votes, regulatory clearances, and potential competing bids in the rare earths sector.
